title: A rate as of a date: the newest record is not always the answer
goal: Write two own tariff facts and verify before, at and before the first boundary.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P5. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: Today the rate is 150, but the work occurred on 14 November. Which historical rate applies? Begin with “as of which date”, rather than the last row in a list.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Facts by key
paragraphs: An information register suits rates by service and time. Service is a dimension, rate a resource, and period adds history. An attribute stores extra description rather than replacing the key. Start from “which rate applied toS1 atD”; one current card price cannot answer the historical question.

Create independent day-periodic information register ТарифыУслуг: Услуга: CatalogRef.Услуги dimension and Тариф: Number(15,2) resource. Период is its platform period field, not a second custom date. The card’s ТарифЗаЧас is distinct and unchanged; this exercise implements no automatic costing.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: One new service has 100 from 1 November and 150 from 15 November. The slice on 14 November returns 100, and on 15 November returns 150. Before the first record there is no matching value:an empty slice does not imply a zero rate.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Periodicity limits distinguishable states
paragraphs: Two records for one service in one period follow the key policy. Daily periodicity cannot distinguish two intraday changes under the same key. Do not substitute current time just to bypass a collision. Choose required precision and test exactly at a rate-change boundary.

The function creates an own service and facts November 1=100 and 15=150. СрезПоследних filtered by its reference returns 100 on 14 and 150 on 15. It selects current state per key rather than summing 250, without including other services.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Can the 14 November result use 150 because it is the newer row?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. СрезПоследних selects the latest value effective at the requested moment, within the service filter. “Latest” removes neither the time boundary nor the dimension filter.

sections.title: A slice is not a sum of prices
paragraphs: Between changes, use the latest applicable rate rather than summing history. SliceLast represents state at a time; record sets represent history. Explicitly return absence or reject when no prior rate exists. Automatic zero can resemble a free service and hide missing data.

Before the first fact there are no rows. Missing and zero tariffs differ and need an explicit calculation policy. Day periodicity does not distinguish two changes inside the same day/key; a different requirement needs different periodicity/key design.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram compares lookup moments rather than four register records. There are two actual changes; the other nodes are questions asked of that history.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Removing the service filter and taking the first result can produce a plausible rate belonging to another service. Use the own service’s unique reference even when display names match.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Test history at boundary dates
paragraphs: Set rate 100 fromD1 and 150 fromD2. Expect absence beforeD1, 100 betweenD1/D2, and 150 at the agreed inclusiveD2 boundary. Reopen and verify. Repeating the same keys must not increase count; editing copy rates must preserve the source.

A compilable 151 mutation fails the independent 150 boundary expectation. This uses an actual register, not a browser array. Each run creates a new own service; retain the function/protocol and remove the startup call.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create another new service:600 from 1 November and 900 from 15 November. Retrieve its rates on 14 and 15 November. Create another service with no history and verify its slice is empty. Preserve older services and rates.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.
